Luna and Astra Part Ways

Two frontier models wrote one program each for the same forty stack-machine tasks. Their verdicts differ on twenty. This page steps through five of them, op by op, so the stack itself shows where each solver went wrong.

luna gpt-5.6-luna · OpenAI API · effort high · 2026-09-01 astra gpt-6-astra · codex exec · effort high · 2026-09-10

Scoreboard

Same tasks, same grader, one candidate per task

A program is solved when it reproduces every shown pair and every held-out pair; memorised when it fits the shown pairs and fails the hidden ones; failed otherwise, which splits into programs that run and compute the wrong thing and programs the machine refuses to run.
